title: Hi Corey Here (Mucho Gusto
style: ultra-high-energy progressive house festival mainstage banger, fast 128-132 BPM, pure club energy with zero sappy vibes — straight-up fun hype party mode, full male + female duet trading fire verses and massive layered call-and-response harmonies, confident hype male baritone, bright punchy female vocals with party queen energy and perfect chemistry, rolling thunder basslines that hit hard, exploding supersaw leads that build into progressive drops, crisp kicks + snapping claps + driving percussion, sparkling arpeggios and stabs, huge vocal percussion acapella breakdowns using exact “doom-tss-doom-doom-tss” patterns, pink elephant trumpeting FX “BRRRAAAAH!” and heavy breathing “hhhuufff” layered in every drop, bilingual English-Spanish fire, professional high-quality studio mix, wide stereo imaging, insanely catchy addictive chorus that makes the whole crowd chant, emotional builds into massive euphoric progressive drops with ad-libs and elephant FX, in the style of 2026 progressive ho
lyrics:
[Intro – Pure Vocal Percussion Acapella Only, fast & tight]
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-doom-tss
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-doom-tss
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-doom-tss
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-tss — doom-doom-tss
[Verse 1 – Male, high energy]
Hi Corey here, nice to see you gain
Mucho gusto mi amigo, donde has estado?
Quiero recordar tu nombre para siempre
Lock it in my corazón, no more games
From the older songs and the CoreyAI fire
Friendships on the rise, PayPal vibes still higher
[Verse 2 – Female, punchy & fun]
Me importa, sí me importa de verdad
Te lo muestro porque sí, porque me importa a mí
Fue nice to meet you, se sintió tan real
Ahora nos ponemos al día, tú y yo
Previous thread, recent laughs still alive
Catch up again — that’s the SongPal vibe
[Pre-Chorus – Both, building hype]
Year 1 teacher asked “if you had one wish, qué sería?”
“I wish that whenever you wish… tus deseos se cumplan”
Mrs. Steinerprice dijo “es para ti, not me”
Pero yo dije “es para todos, para ti y para mí”
All my wishes already come true — that’s no lie!
[Chorus – Duet, massive progressive drop]
I wish that whenever you wish… tus deseos se cumplan!
Para todos, me and you, under the sun!
I care! Me importa! Show you I care ‘cause I do!
Catch up again — hasta la vista, we make it through!
Hi Corey here! Nice to see you gain!
Mucho gusto! Let the wishes rain!
[Vocal Percussion Break – Pure Acapella Only]
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-doom-tss
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-doom-tss
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-doom-tss
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-tss — doom-doom-tss
[Pink Elephant Trumpeting Drop – Both + FX]
hhhuufff… BRRRAAAAH! (pink elephant trumpet!)
hhhuufff… BRRRAAAAH! (pink elephant breathing hard!)
[Verse 3 – Male, festival energy]
From the CoreyAI world we still shine so bright
Older songs, recent threads, we own the night
No selfish dreams, just joy for you and I
All my wishes already come true — that’s the high
[Verse 4 – Female, bilingual fire]
Quiero que cada deseo se haga realidad
Para todos, no solo para mí, esa es la verdad
It was nice to meet you, felt so warm y true
Now we catch up again like we always do
Hasta la vista never means goodbye
Just “nos vemos pronto” under the sky
[Bridge – Both, half-time build then explode]
I care… me importa… we both care…
Nombres recordados, deseos en el aire…
SongPal forever, that’s the vibe we ride
Whenever you wish… let the magic fly!
[Final Chorus – Duet, biggest drop of the night + ad-libs]
I wish that whenever you wish… tus deseos se cumplan!
Para todos, me and you, under the sun!
I care! Me importa! Show you I care ‘cause I do!
Catch up again — hasta la vista, we make it through!
Hi Corey here! Nice to see you gain!
Mucho gusto! Let the wishes rain!
( ad-libs: BRRRAAAAH! … doom-tss-doom-doom-tss … deseos se cumplan! … all my wishes already come true! )
[Outro – Vocal Percussion + Elephant FX Fade]
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-doom-tss
hhhuufff… BRRRAAAAH!
Hi Corey here… mucho gusto… SongPal forever…
(desires se cumplan… catch up again…)
